description: Sets the default folder Rhino uses when opening and saving files - a small tidy-up that keeps project files landing in the right place during a long session.

name: SetZoomExtentsBorder
description: Adjusts how much breathing space Zoom Extents leaves around the model, as a scale factor. Set it once if you find extents zooms habitually too tight or too loose.

name: Shade
description: Temporarily displays the viewport shaded regardless of its display mode. A quick look at form and shadow while staying in wireframe workflows.

name: ShadeSelected
description: Displays a temporary shaded preview of just the selected objects while everything else stays wireframe - a quick look at form without changing display modes.

name: Shear
description: Slants objects at an angle while keeping their base fixed. Used for leaning facades, italic-style extrusions and racking studies.

name: Shell
description: Hollows a closed solid to a set wall thickness, removing the faces you pick as openings. Ideal for turning massing volumes into thin-walled enclosures in one move.

name: ShortPath
description: Draws the shortest path (geodesic) curve across a surface between two points - the route a taut string would take over the form. Useful for seam lines, panelling set-out and edge details on doubly curved surfaces.

name: Show
description: Reveals all hidden objects at once. The blanket undo for a session's worth of hiding.

name: ShowDir
description: Displays direction and normal arrows on curves and surfaces persistently while you carry on working, unlike Dir's temporary display. Turn the arrows off with ShowDirOff.

name: ShowDirOff
description: Turns off the persistent direction arrows displayed by ShowDir once you have finished checking curve directions and surface normals.

name: ShowEdges
description: Highlights the edges of surfaces and meshes, with naked and non-manifold edges picked out in colour. The go-to diagnostic when a join fails or a solid will not close.

name: ShowEdgesOff
description: Turns off the edge highlighting left by ShowEdges once you have finished hunting naked and non-manifold edges.

name: ShowEnds
description: Marks the ends of open curves on screen so stray gaps in linework stand out - a great companion when tidying drawings into closed profiles for surfacing or hatching.

name: ShowEndsOff
description: Turns off the curve-end markers displayed by ShowEnds when the linework clean-up is done.

name: ShowInDetail
description: Reveals objects that were hidden in a particular layout detail, restoring per-detail visibility without affecting the model or other views.

name: ShowLayersInDetail
description: Turns layers back on inside a chosen detail after they were hidden there, letting each drawing view on a layout carry its own layer set.

name: ShowOsnap
description: Opens the object snap control so you can tick which snaps - end, mid, centre and the rest - are live while you model.

name: ShowRenderMesh
description: Displays the render mesh that shading and rendering use to approximate NURBS objects, so you can judge whether the mesh is fine enough before rendering or export.

name: ShowSelected
description: Temporarily displays hidden objects so you can pick which ones to reveal, leaving the rest hidden. Precision control when only some hidden items should return.

name: ShowSelectedInDetail
description: Shows chosen hidden objects in the active detail only, giving precise per-view control over what each drawing on a layout displays.

name: ShowToolbar
description: Shows a toolbar you name, restoring it after it was closed - the companion to HideToolbar in workspace-arranging macros.

name: ShowZBuffer
description: Displays the viewport's depth buffer as a greyscale image, with distance from the camera mapped to tone. Occasionally handy for producing depth maps used in post-production and illustration.

name: ShrinkTrimmedSrf
description: Shrinks the hidden underlying surface of a trimmed face so it sits closely around the trim boundary. Good housekeeping before matching, exporting or editing control points.

name: ShrinkTrimmedSrfToEdge
description: Shrinks a trimmed surface's underlying surface right up to a selected trim edge, cutting away the invisible excess sheet beyond the trims. A finer-grained variant of ShrinkTrimmedSrf.

name: ShrinkWrap
description: Wraps a watertight mesh tightly around any collection of geometry, meshes or point clouds. A Rhino 8 favourite for turning messy scans and mixed models into a single printable solid mesh.

name: Silhouette
description: Extracts outline curves of objects as seen from the current view or a set direction. Useful for shadow studies, elevational outlines and preparing artwork from 3D models.

name: SimplifyCrv
description: Replaces segments of a polycurve with true lines and arcs where possible, reducing clutter. Excellent for cleaning up curves imported from CAD drawings.

name: SingleSubDFace
description: Creates one standalone SubD face from picked corner points. The seed for box-modelling a form face by face with AppendFace.

name: Sketch
description: Draws a freehand curve that follows the dragged cursor, optionally on a surface or mesh. Handy for loose concept lines and annotating models during design reviews.

name: Slab
description: Offsets a planar curve and extrudes the result into a solid with thickness and height in one step. A quick way to raise walls from single plan lines.

name: Smash
description: Roughly flattens a surface that is only slightly doubly curved, ignoring small distortions. A quick-and-dirty alternative to Squish for near-developable panels.

name: Smooth
description: Averages out control point positions to relax curves, surfaces or meshes, with per-axis control. Good for calming noisy traced linework or lumpy meshes.

name: Snap
description: Toggles grid snap, making the cursor jump to grid intersections - the command behind the status bar's Snap pane. Useful for quick orthogonal set-out at regular spacings.

name: Snapshots
description: Saves named states combining view, layer visibility, object states and more, with animated transitions between them. Powerful for presenting design options and phasing from one model.

name: SnapSize
description: Sets the grid snap spacing - the distance between the invisible points the cursor jumps to when Snap is on. Match it to your planning grid or module.

name: SnapToLocked
description: Toggles whether object snaps engage locked objects. Turn it on to draw accurately over a locked survey or base drawing without risk of moving it.

name: SnapToMeshObject
description: Toggles whether object snaps find points on mesh objects - switch it off when heavy scan meshes keep hijacking snaps meant for your NURBS model.

name: SnapToOccluded
description: Toggles snapping to geometry hidden behind other objects in shaded views. Off means you only snap to what you can see; on lets you reach through the model to covered points.

name: SnapToSubDObject
description: Toggles whether object snaps engage SubD objects, letting you decide if snaps should land on smooth SubD forms while drawing around them.

name: SoftEditCrv
description: Drags a point on a curve while nearby regions follow with a smooth falloff. Ideal for nudging long design curves without introducing kinks or editing individual control points.

name: SoftEditSrf
description: Drags a point on a surface with a smooth circular falloff so the surrounding region follows naturally. Ideal for sculpting gentle bumps and hollows into terrain or shell forms.

name: SoftMove
description: Moves geometry or control points with a smooth falloff from a centre, like a soft magnet. Useful for organic nudges to terrain and sculpted surfaces.

name: SoftTransform
description: Moves, rotates or scales a selection with a smooth falloff, so nearby control points or sub-objects follow progressively less. Sculpting-style editing for SubDs, meshes and dense control-point grids.

name: SolidPtOn
description: Turns on grip points at the corners and edges of a solid so they can be dragged directly. A light-touch way to deform boxes and simple polysurfaces without exploding them.

name: Sphere
description: Creates a solid sphere from centre and radius or other constructions. Used for domes, finials and quick volumetric placeholders.

name: SphereTangentToThreeSurfaces
description: Draws a sphere tangent to three chosen surfaces - a specialist construction useful for fillet set-outs, packing studies and finding the ball that just fits a corner.

name: Spiral
description: Draws a flat or conical spiral with controllable turns and radii. Useful for ramps, spiral geometry studies and decorative patterns.

name: Split
description: Divides objects into pieces where cutters cross them, keeping every part. Preferred over Trim when you want to recolour, move or keep both sides of a cut.

name: SplitDisjointMesh
description: Breaks a mesh containing unconnected pieces into separate mesh objects. The bulk version of ExtractMeshPart for cleaning imported models.

name: SplitEdge
description: Splits a surface or polysurface edge at points you pick, so the resulting edge segments can be joined, matched or blended independently. MergeEdge reverses it.

name: SplitFace
description: Divides a planar face of a solid along a curve or between points without breaking the solid apart. Sets up sub-faces that MoveFace or PushPull can then manipulate independently.

name: SplitMeshEdge
description: Splits a mesh edge at a point, adding a vertex and dividing the neighbouring faces - low-level mesh surgery for adding local detail or fixing awkward triangulation.

name: SplitMeshWithCurve
description: Splits a mesh along a curve projected onto it - the standard way to cut panel lines, site boundaries or trim edges into scan and terrain meshes.

name: SplitPointCloud
description: Splits a point cloud into separate clouds, letting you carve a large scan into manageable chunks - one cloud per building, floor or zone.

name: SplitViewportHorizontal
description: Splits the active viewport into two stacked views, giving you an extra viewport without rebuilding the whole layout - useful for a quick plan-over-perspective pairing.

name: SplitViewportVertical
description: Splits the active viewport into two side-by-side views - a fast way to work in two views at once without switching to a four-view layout.

name: Splop
description: Copies and morphs an object from a plane onto a surface at picked points, with rotate and scale control while placing. Fun and fast for stamping repeated ornaments over curved forms.

name: Sporph
description: Morphs objects from one surface's parameter space to another's, deforming them between the two shapes. Used to migrate detailed geometry between design iterations of a surface.

name: Squish
description: Flattens doubly curved surfaces or meshes by allowing controlled stretching and compression, and can report the distortion. Used to pattern fabric panels, upholstery and stretch ceilings.

name: SquishBack
description: Takes geometry drawn on a squished (flattened) surface and maps it back onto the original 3D form. Draw your pattern, graphics or cut lines flat, then return them to the curved surface.

name: SquishInfo
description: Reports how a squished object relates to its 3D original, including the flattening data that SquishBack relies on - a check that the link between flat and curved versions is intact.

name: SrfControlPtGrid
description: Creates a surface from a rectangular grid of points used as control points - the surface is smoothed and guided by the grid rather than passing through it. Useful for building clean freeform surfaces from set-out data.

name: SrfPt
description: Creates a surface by picking three or four corner points. Quick for simple planes and twisted quads such as warped roof panels.

name: SrfPtGrid
description: Creates a surface that passes through a rectangular grid of points - handy for rebuilding surveyed terrain or spreadsheet-derived surfaces where the points must be honoured exactly.

name: SrfSeam
description: Relocates the seam of a closed surface to a different isocurve position. Fixes texture, trim and matching issues that cluster around a badly placed seam.

name: STEPTree
description: Shows the assembly structure of a STEP file, so the product tree from an imported engineering model can be browsed and worked with rather than arriving as an anonymous heap of geometry.

name: Stitch
description: Zips selected SubD or mesh edges together so they become shared edges. The tool for closing gaps and welding sculpted parts into one continuous body.

name: Stretch
description: Elongates only the middle region of objects along an axis, leaving the ends undistorted. Ideal for lengthening a chair rail or window while keeping its end details intact.

name: SubCrv
description: Extracts the portion of a curve between two picked points, either shortening the original or copying just that stretch. Quicker than splitting and deleting when you only need part of a curve.

name: SubDBox
description: Creates a SubD box with a chosen number of faces per side. A common starting block for organic massing that will be sculpted by pushing points and edges.

name: SubDCone
description: Creates a SubD cone primitive for sculpting tapered organic shapes. Handy for tent-like and horn-like starting volumes.

name: SubDCrease
description: Makes selected SubD edges or vertices fully creased, so the smooth surface carries a sharp corner or arris there. The way to mix crisp architectural edges into otherwise soft SubD forms.

name: SubDCylinder
description: Creates a SubD cylinder with configurable face counts. A clean starting point for soft columns, trunks and limb-like forms.

name: SubDDisplayToggle
description: Switches SubD display between smooth and flat (boxy control cage) modes. Designers flip to flat mode for precise topology edits, then back to judge the smooth result.

name: SubDEllipsoid
description: Draws an ellipsoid as a SubD object, giving you a smooth stretched-sphere primitive ready for organic push-and-pull editing.

name: SubDExpandEdges
description: Expands selected SubD edges into narrow strips of faces, adding topology either side of a feature line so you can control how tightly the surface turns there.

name: SubDFaceEdgeVertexToggle
description: Cycles the sub-object selection filter between SubD faces, edges and vertices - usually run from a keyboard shortcut so you can flip picking modes mid-edit without leaving the viewport.

name: Subdivide
description: Splits selected SubD or mesh faces into smaller faces for denser local control. Used when one area of a sculpt needs much finer modelling than the rest.

name: SubDLoft
description: Lofts a series of profile curves into a SubD surface with clean quad flow. A Rhino 8 addition for building smooth sculptable skins straight from section curves.

name: SubDPlane
description: Creates a flat SubD plane divided into a grid of faces. The usual canvas for sculpting terrain-like or draped SubD surfaces.

name: SubDSphere
description: Creates a smooth SubD sphere built from quad faces. Useful as a base for organic forms like pods, boulders and soft furniture.

name: SubDSpinEdge
description: Rotates an interior SubD edge so it connects different corners of the neighbouring faces, rerouting topology without adding or removing points - useful for cleaning up awkward flow in a SubD mesh.

name: SubDSweep1
description: Sweeps profiles along one rail to produce a SubD rather than a NURBS surface. Keeps concept geometry light and editable for further sculpting.

name: SubDSweep2
description: Sweeps profiles along two rails to build a SubD skin controlled at both edges. Useful for organic canopies and seat shells that need later point editing.

name: SubDTorus
description: Creates a SubD ring primitive. A useful base for smooth loops, seating rings and continuous banded forms.

name: SubDTruncatedCone
description: Draws a truncated cone as a SubD object - a smooth frustum primitive for organic modelling, tapering columns and vessel-like forms.

name: Sun
description: Controls a sun light by date, time and location for accurate shadows. Essential for daylight and rights-of-light style studies directly in the viewport.

name: SwapMeshEdge
description: Flips the diagonal edge shared by two triangular mesh faces, changing how their quad is divided - a classic fix for ugly shading and creasing in triangulated meshes.

name: SwapView
description: Exchanges the view shown in the active viewport with that of another viewport - quick reshuffling of your workspace without redefining cameras.

name: Sweep1
description: Runs one or more cross-section shapes along a single rail curve to build a surface. Ideal for handrails, mouldings and extrusion-like forms that follow a curved path.

name: Sweep2
description: Builds a surface by carrying cross-sections along two rail curves, keeping both edges under control. The tool of choice when a shape must hit two defined boundary curves.

name: Symmetry
description: Mirrors a curve or SubD edge across a plane and keeps the join smooth, with history so edits stay symmetrical. Used for precise symmetrical design curves and SubD halves.

name: SynchronizeCPlanes
description: Applies the active viewport's construction plane to the other viewports, keeping CPlanes consistent while you work on a tilted or rotated plane across several views.

name: SynchronizeRenderColors
description: Brings render material colours and object display colours into line with each other, so shaded views and renders agree - useful for quick colour-coded massing and option studies.

name: SystemInfo
description: Prints a report of Rhino's version, graphics hardware and loaded plug-ins. The first thing support asks for when troubleshooting display or stability issues.

name: Taper
description: Scales an object progressively along an axis so it narrows or widens towards one end. Quick way to give massing a tapering silhouette.

name: TCone
description: Creates a truncated cone between two circular ends of different radii. Handy for tapered columns, hoppers and flared connections.

name: Text
description: Places a block of annotation text at a picked point, styled by the current annotation style. Used for titles, notes and labels throughout drawings.

name: TextObject
description: Generates real geometry from text as curves, surfaces or solids. Reach for it for signage, embossed lettering and CNC-cut graphics rather than annotation.

name: TextProperties
description: Opens the settings for selected text objects so their content, font and formatting can be changed - a direct route into text editing alongside the Properties panel.

name: Textures
description: Opens the Textures panel, where the image and procedural textures in the document are created and managed for use in materials, environments and decals.

name: ThicknessAnalysis
description: Colour-maps the wall thickness of closed solids or meshes between set limits. Valuable for checking shelled components and 3D print walls before fabrication.

name: ThicknessAnalysisOff
description: Turns off the false-colour thickness analysis display once you have finished checking wall thicknesses for printing or fabrication.

name: TiltView
description: Rolls the camera about its own axis, tilting the horizon of the view. Occasionally useful for dramatic perspectives, or for levelling a named view that has picked up an accidental tilt.

name: ToggleFloatingViewport
description: Floats the active viewport as its own window, or docks it back into the main layout - handy for throwing a perspective view onto a second monitor while drafting in the first.

name: ToggleLeftSidebar
description: Shows or hides the left sidebar of the Rhino window, freeing screen space for the viewports on smaller displays.

name: ToggleRenderMesh
description: Toggles display of objects' render meshes on and off - a quick way to inspect the mesh that sits behind shaded and rendered display.

name: ToggleRightSidebar
description: Shows or hides the right sidebar of the Rhino window - typically the Properties and panel stack - to give viewports more room.

name: ToNURBS
description: Converts SubD or mesh objects into NURBS surfaces and polysurfaces. Used when a sculpted concept needs precise trimming, filleting or export to documentation.

name: ToolbarLock
description: Locks the toolbar layout so buttons and toolbars cannot be dragged out of place by stray clicks - worth switching on once your workspace is arranged.

name: Torus
description: Creates a solid ring from a centre, ring radius and tube radius. Occasionally needed for handrail loops, gaskets and toroidal architectural forms.

name: ToSubD
description: Converts meshes, NURBS surfaces or extrusions into SubD objects. The gateway for bringing existing geometry into Rhino's smooth sculpting workflow.

name: TriangulateMesh
description: Splits all quad mesh faces into triangles. Required by some export formats and analysis tools that only accept triangulated geometry.

name: TriangulateNonPlanarQuads
description: Splits only the non-planar quad faces of a mesh into triangles, fixing the faces that some exporters and engines reject while leaving flat quads untouched.

name: TriangulateRenderMeshes
description: Triangulates the render meshes of selected objects, useful when a downstream renderer or file format cannot cope with quad faces.

name: Trim
description: Cuts away the parts of objects you click, using other objects as cutting edges. Together with Split and Join, the core editing operation in every Rhino session.

name: TruncatedCone
description: Draws a solid truncated cone - a cone with its top sliced off flat. The frustum primitive for tapered columns, hoppers, lampshades and planters.

name: TruncatedPyramid
description: Draws a solid truncated pyramid - a pyramid cut off flat before its apex. Useful for plinths, rooflights, pad foundations and battered walls.

name: Tube
description: Creates a hollow straight cylinder with wall thickness in one operation. Quicker than boolean-subtracting two cylinders for sleeves and ducts.

name: Turntable
description: Spins the model continuously in the viewport. A simple way to review a design from all sides or run an impromptu presentation loop.

name: Tutorials
description: Opens Rhino's tutorials panel, with guided lessons and sample files - a good signpost for newcomers finding their way around the program.

name: TweenCurves
description: Generates intermediate curves evenly blended between two input curves. Great for louvre arrays, contour infills and transitional profiles between two design conditions.

name: TweenSurfaces
description: Creates one or more surfaces evenly interpolated between two input surfaces - useful for louvre arrays, stepped facades and transitional forms that morph from one shape to another.

name: Twist
description: Rotates an object progressively along an axis so it spirals between start and end angles. The instant twisted-tower and helical-fin tool.

name: Undo
description: Steps back through recent commands, reversing changes to the model. The most pressed shortcut in any session.

name: UndoMultiple
description: Undoes several steps in one go by letting you choose how far back to unwind, instead of hammering Ctrl+Z and hoping.

name: UndoSelection
description: Restores the previous selection set - a rescue when a mis-click deselects the collection of objects you had carefully built up.

name: UndoView
description: Steps back through recent view changes without touching geometry. Rescues you after an accidental zoom or orbit loses a carefully framed view.

name: Ungroup
description: Dissolves the selected group back into independent objects. The exit route when grouped items need separate editing.

name: UngroupAll
description: Removes all levels of grouping from the selection in one go, where Ungroup only peels off the top level of nested groups.

name: UnifyMeshNormals
description: Flips inconsistent face normals so the whole mesh points one way. A standard repair before boolean operations, rendering or 3D printing.

name: Unisolate
description: Restores the objects hidden by the last Isolate. Returns the full model after focused work.

name: UnisolateFromViewports
description: Ends per-viewport isolation, bringing back objects that had been hidden in particular viewports so all views show the full model again.

name: UnisolateLock
description: Reverses IsolateLock, unlocking the objects that were locked so you could work on an isolated selection undisturbed.

name: UnjoinEdge
description: Un-joins edges that were force-joined with JoinEdge, restoring them as separate naked edges - a sensible first step before rebuilding a dubious joint properly.

name: Unlock
description: Releases all locked objects so they can be selected again. Blanket partner to Lock.

name: UnlockSelected
description: Lets you pick specific locked objects to release while others stay locked. Fine-grained partner to Unlock for busy reference-heavy files.

name: UnpackTextures
description: Saves the texture images embedded in the 3dm file out to a folder on disk, so they can be edited, replaced or shared separately from the model.

name: UnrollSrf
description: Flattens developable (single-curvature) surfaces onto a plane, with their marked curves and labels. Essential for fabrication drawings of sheet metal, timber veneers and curved cladding.

name: Untrim
description: Removes a trim boundary and restores the full underlying surface, optionally keeping the trimming curves. Used to recover clean geometry when a trim needs rethinking.

name: UntrimAll
description: Removes every trim from a surface, recovering the full underlying sheet - the fastest way to strip out holes and cut edges when you want to start the trimming again.

name: UntrimBorder
description: Removes only the outer trim boundary of a surface, restoring the full sheet while keeping any interior holes intact.

name: UntrimHoles
description: Removes the interior holes from a trimmed surface while keeping its outer boundary - ideal for blanking off openings before re-detailing a facade or panel.

name: Unweld
description: Splits mesh vertices along edges above a crease angle so those edges shade as sharp. Used to restore crisp arris lines on smoothed meshes.

name: UnweldEdge
description: Unwelds only the specific mesh edges you pick, making them shade as creases. Precise control over which lines read sharp in a rendered mesh.

name: Unwrap
description: Flattens an object's surface into UV texture space, using seam edges you choose, so textures can be applied or painted without stretching - the starting point for serious texture-mapping work.

name: UseExtrusions
description: Sets whether commands such as Box, Cylinder and ExtrudeCrv create lightweight extrusion objects or full polysurfaces. Extrusions keep big repetitive models fast; polysurfaces suit heavy downstream editing.

name: UVEditor
description: Opens the UV editor, which shows a flattened copy of the object's texture coordinates that you edit to control exactly how textures wrap the model.

name: VariableBlendSrf
description: Creates a smooth blend surface between edges with its size and shape varying along the run, controlled by handles - for transitions that need to swell and tighten along their length.

name: VariableChamferSrf
description: Chamfers between surfaces with distances that vary along the edge, set by handles - angled transitions that change width along their run.

name: VariableFilletSrf
description: Fillets between surfaces with a radius that varies along the edge, adjusted by handles - for fillets that need to grow or shrink along a run rather than stay constant.

name: VariableOffsetSrf
description: Offsets a surface with different distances at chosen points, blending smoothly between them. Useful when a shell or panel must thicken structurally in some zones only.

name: ViewCaptureToClipboard
description: Copies a viewport image straight to the clipboard for pasting into emails, decks and documents. The fastest route from model to meeting note.

name: ViewCaptureToFile
description: Saves an image of the viewport at chosen resolution, with options for grid and widget visibility. The workhorse for quick design-study images without full rendering.

name: ViewFirstFrame
description: Jumps the animation preview to its first frame, taking you back to the start of a recorded fly-through or sun study.

name: ViewFrameNumber
description: Jumps the animation preview to a frame number you type - useful for checking a specific moment in a fly-through or sun study without playing the whole sequence.

name: ViewLastFrame
description: Jumps the animation preview to its final frame - a quick check of how a fly-through or sun study ends.

name: ViewNextFrame
description: Steps the animation preview forward one frame, letting you inspect a camera path or sun study frame by frame.

name: ViewportTabs
description: Shows or hides the viewport tabs along the edge of the graphics area - the quick way to flip between viewports and layout pages.

name: ViewPreviousFrame
description: Steps the animation preview back one frame - the partner to ViewNextFrame when scrubbing through a recorded sequence.

name: Volume
description: Calculates the enclosed volume of closed solids or meshes. Key for cut-and-fill studies, concrete quantities and capacity checks.

name: VolumeCentroid
description: Finds the centre of mass of closed volumes and marks it with a point. Used in stability and rigging studies for heavy elements.

name: VolumeMoments
description: Calculates volume, centroid and moments of inertia for closed solids - engineering-grade mass-property data straight from the model, useful for structural and stability checks.

name: Walkabout
description: Moves the camera at eye level with walking-style controls. Handy for checking interior spatial experience without setting up a full walkthrough.

name: WebBrowser
description: Opens a simple web browser panel inside Rhino - occasionally useful for keeping reference pages, product data or web tools alongside the model.

name: Weight
description: Edits the weight of selected control points, changing how strongly they pull the curve or surface towards them - higher weights tighten the shape locally, lower weights slacken it. A rational-geometry tool for fine control.

name: Weld
description: Merges coincident mesh vertices within an angle tolerance so faces share smooth shading. Fixes faceted-looking seams on imported meshes.

name: WeldEdge
description: Welds the mesh vertices along chosen edges so the adjoining faces share them and shade smoothly across the join - targeted smoothing where Weld's angle-based approach is too blunt.

name: WeldVertices
description: Welds selected mesh vertices so the faces around them share single vertices, removing the shading splits at those points - handy for spot-fixing seams in a mesh.

name: What
description: Prints a detailed report of an object's type, structure and validity. First stop for identifying mystery geometry in inherited files.

name: WindowLayout
description: Saves and restores named arrangements of Rhino's windows, panels and toolbars - one layout for modelling, another for drafting, another for rendering, switched in a click.

name: WireCut
description: Slices a solid using a curve projected through it, keeping or discarding the pieces you choose. An intuitive cutter for stepped facades and profile-driven subtractions.

name: Worksession
description: Attaches other Rhino files as read-only references around your active file, so a team can split a big project into parts. Rhino's answer to external references for large-project collaboration.

name: Zebra
description: Projects stripe patterns onto surfaces so continuity flaws show as kinked or broken stripes. The quickest visual check of how smoothly surfaces meet.

name: ZebraOff
description: Turns off the zebra-stripe analysis display once you have finished checking surface smoothness and continuity.

name: Zoom
description: Zooms the viewport by window, extents, selected objects or factor. Its aliases make framing the whole model or a selection a two-keystroke habit.

name: Zoom1To1Calibrate
description: Calibrates your monitor by measuring a known distance on screen, so that Zoom 1To1 can display the model at true real-world size - useful for judging details and text at actual scale.

name: ZoomLens
description: Changes the active perspective view's lens length, zooming by focal length rather than moving the camera - wide angle for interiors, long lens for flatter, elevational-feeling perspectives.

name: ZoomNaked
description: Steps the view through each naked edge on the selected objects, zooming to them one by one so open joints can be inspected and repaired - the natural follow-up to ShowEdges.

name: ZoomNonManifold
description: Steps the view through each non-manifold edge on the selected objects, zooming to every spot where more than two faces meet an edge - the fastest way to inspect the defects that break printing and Booleans.
